item.title: EplayerX 1.2.14
item.description:
## 更新日志
- 新增 Emby 播放列表浏览，按服务器顺序展示内容，并支持分页加载和重复条目。 - 新增杜比视界 Profile 7 转 Profile 8.1 播放选项，可在播放设置中开启，默认关闭。 - 修复部分 Emby 服务器播放列表无法正常显示的问题。 - 修复字幕翻译开关切换后，设置状态未能立即更新的问题。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What's New
- Added Emby playlist browsing with server-defined ordering, pagination, and support for repeated entries. - Added an optional Dolby Vision Profile 7 to Profile 8.1 playback setting, disabled by default. - Fixed playlists not appearing correctly on some Emby servers. - Fixed subtitle translation toggles not immediately reflecting their updated state.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
